subject: Export fails for archived invoices
description:
The nightly export stopped including archived invoices after the March migration.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Open Billing > Exports
2. Choose "All invoices", including archived
3. The file contains only open invoices

The finance team needs the full export before quarter close.
internal_notes: Root cause looks like the archived flag being dropped by the new sync job. Workaround: re-run the export with the legacy flag enabled. Do not offer another extension; they already had two this year.

subject: SSO login loops back to sign-in page
description: Users in the Warehouse group are sent back to the sign-in page after authenticating. Other groups are fine. Started after their identity provider rotated certificates on Friday.
internal_notes: Asked their IT contact for the new metadata XML. Certificate fingerprint on our side is still the old one.

subject: Dashboard totals differ from report
description: The dashboard shows 1,204 appointments for August, the downloaded report shows 1,187. The difference is the 17 appointments created between midnight and 2am UTC on the 1st.
internal_notes: Timezone mismatch between the warehouse (UTC) and the reporting layer (local). Fixed in release 4.18.2.

subject: Request: dark mode for embedded player
description: Would like the embedded player to follow the host page's color scheme.

subject: API returns 429 during bulk import
description:
Bulk import of 40,000 parts fails about a third of the way through with HTTP 429. Retries succeed but the job takes hours.

They are well under the documented rate limit of 600 requests per minute.
internal_notes: Limit is being applied per IP, and their integration runs behind a shared NAT. Raise with platform team.

subject: Invoice PDF shows wrong VAT number
description: The VAT number on invoice PDFs is the old one. It was updated in settings two weeks ago.
internal_notes: Template cache was not invalidated when billing details changed. Cleared the cache; fix scheduled.

subject: Webhook deliveries delayed by 20 minutes
description: Webhooks for "record.updated" arrive 15 to 25 minutes late since Tuesday. Order is preserved.
internal_notes: Queue backlog on the us-east-1 delivery workers. Capacity was added on the 5th; watching.

subject: Cannot change workspace owner
description: The current owner left the company. The transfer button is disabled for admins.
internal_notes: Needs identity verification from a second admin before support can transfer ownership.

subject: CSV import treats semicolons as text
description: Importing a semicolon-separated file puts every row into one column. The same file opens fine in their spreadsheet app.
internal_notes: Delimiter detection only samples the first line, which is a title row in their file.

subject: Mobile app crashes when scanning barcode
description: The app closes immediately when the scanner opens on older devices. Newer devices are fine.
internal_notes: Camera permission prompt regression in 7.4.0. Fixed in 7.4.1.

subject: Audit log missing entries for bulk edits
description: Bulk edits made through the API do not appear in the audit log. Edits made in the UI do. This blocks their compliance review on the 15th.
internal_notes: Bulk endpoint bypasses the audit middleware. Hotfix in review.

subject: Storage usage shown as 0 GB
description: Usage page shows 0 GB although about 300 GB of video is uploaded.
